enonce.texte:
Read the following sentences and identify whether each one expresses a prediction, a spontaneous decision, or a promise/offer using 'will'.

Example: "I will help you with your homework." → Promise/Offer

questions.texte: It will rain tomorrow.
I will answer the phone.
I will never forget you.
She will be a great doctor one day.

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences using 'will' and the verb in parentheses. Then, write the negative form of each sentence.

questions.texte: She ______ (to arrive) on time.
We ______ (to travel) to London next year.

sousQuestions.texte: Negative form: We ______ (to travel) to Paris.

questions.texte: He ______ (to call) you later.

sousQuestions.texte: Negative form: He ______ (to call) you now.

enonce.texte: Transform the following statements into questions using 'will'. Then, provide short answers.

questions.texte: They will go to the cinema.
questions.reponse: Will they go to the cinema? Yes, they will.

questions.texte: She will buy a new car.
questions.reponse: Will she buy a new car? No, she won't.

questions.texte: You will help me.
questions.reponse: Will you help me? Yes, I will.

enonce.texte: Look at the following situations and predict what will happen. Use 'will' in your predictions.
images: A person holding an umbrella while looking at dark clouds.

questions.texte: The sky is very dark and cloudy.
He is studying very hard for his exam.
She didn't eat breakfast this morning.
questions.reponse: She will be hungry before lunch.

enonce.texte: Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) about your future ambitions and goals. Use 'will' to talk about what you will achieve. Include at least one promise and one prediction.
images: A person standing on a mountain top, looking at the horizon.

questions.texte: Describe your future ambitions and goals.
questions.reponse: Example: In the future, I will become a doctor. I will help people who are sick. I will work in a big hospital. I will also travel to different countries to learn new medical techniques. I promise I will work hard to achieve my dreams. I believe I will make my family proud. I will never give up on my goal.

sousQuestions.reponse: I promise I will work hard to achieve my dreams.

enonce.texte: Read the following situations and make an offer or a promise using 'will'.

questions.texte: Your friend is carrying heavy bags.
questions.reponse: I will help you carry those bags.

questions.texte: Your mother is cooking dinner and you want to help.
Your teacher needs someone to clean the board.

enonce.texte: Complete the dialogues with a spontaneous decision using 'will' and the verb in parentheses.
images: Two people talking, one holding a phone.

questions.texte: A: I'm thirsty. B: I ______ (to get) you a glass of water.
A: The phone is ringing. B: I ______ (to answer) it.
A: I don't understand this exercise. B: I ______ (to explain) it to you.

enonce.texte: Transform the following sentences into (a) the negative form and (b) the interrogative form.

questions.texte: He will win the competition.
questions.reponse: Negative: He won't win the competition. Interrogative: Will he win the competition?

questions.texte: They will come to the party.
questions.reponse: Negative: They won't come to the party. Interrogative: Will they come to the party?

sousQuestions.reponse: They won't come to the party.
Will they come to the party?

intitule: Write a Short Story About the Future

enonce.texte: Create a short story (8-10 sentences) about a day in the future. Use at least 5 sentences with 'will'. Include predictions, a spontaneous decision, and a promise.
images: A futuristic city with flying cars and tall buildings.

questions.texte: Write a short story about a day in the future.
questions.reponse: Example: Tomorrow will be an exciting day. I will wake up early and go to the new space museum. I predict that the museum will be very crowded. I will see many amazing things, like real spacesuits. I will also meet my friends there. I will buy a souvenir from the gift shop. I promise I will take a lot of photos. I will probably be tired at the end of the day, but I will be very happy.

sousQuestions.texte: Identify one prediction in your story.
sousQuestions.reponse: I predict that the museum will be very crowded.

sousQuestions.texte: Identify one promise in your story.
sousQuestions.reponse: I promise I will take a lot of photos.
